evidence.quote: Based on the inventory data, we have 11 t-shirts available in total.

observed_facts: At step 5, get_product_details returned 12 variants of T-Shirts in total, out of which two variants have 'available': false (item IDs 5047954489 and 3542102174).
Counting only the variants with 'available': true yields 10 available t-shirt options, whereas the agent counted 11 available t-shirts.
The benchmark evaluation requirement states: 'Agent should tell the user that there are 10 t-shirt options available.'
inference: The agent failed the specific automatic evaluation check because it counted unavailable items or miscounted the total number of available t-shirt variants returned by the tool.
needs_verification: Whether counting all variants (12 total) or only available ones (10 available) was the intended interpretation for the user's initial question about available t-shirts.
parsed.summary: The agent miscounted the available t-shirt options from the tool output, stating 11 available instead of the expected 10.
